children: France's EDF aims to build 10 small modular reactors (SMRs) to produce nuclear energy in Europe by 2035, in a project involving its unit Edison
and that could be worth tens of billions of euros, EDF's senior vice president said on Friday.

The French state-owned power group plans to use a technology developed by its NUWARD subsidiary for the SMRs, EDF's Vakisasai Ramany said at an event hosted by Edison and attended by companies that will be part of the nuclear supply chain.
Ramany added that the group is in talks with Poland, Belgium and Finland on the possible construction of part of the 10- reactor fleet.
